article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Balanced autoflowering hybrid
Genetics: Guava × Mango Runtz
Breeder: Fast Buds
THC Content: Up to 30%
CBD Content: Less than 1%
Terpene Profile: N/A
Primary Flavors: Guava, mango, tropical fruit, sweet candy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks from seed to harvest
Outdoor Harvest Time: 8–9 weeks from seed
Indoor Yield: 450–600 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 60–300 g per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to moderate

Guava Runtz Auto brings together two competition-proven autoflower lines with very different personalities. Fast Buds paired its refined Guava Auto RF3 with Mephisto Genetics’ Mango Runtz F5 Auto, creating an F1 feminized hybrid designed around tropical flavor, extreme aroma, resin production, and vigorous growth. The finished cultivar can reach approximately 30% THC while maintaining an even 50/50 indica-sativa balance, giving it considerably more strength than its sweet guava-and-candy flavor might suggest.

Visually, this cultivar can move in two directions. One prominent phenotype develops deep black coloration as flowering progresses, while another stays greener with darker tones appearing close to maturity. Both produce dense resinous flowers and retain a similar tropical terpene profile, allowing growers to find substantial visual diversity without losing the basic character of the strain. Plants reach roughly 70–120 cm, finish in only 8–9 weeks, and can produce up to about 600 g/m² indoors, placing Guava Runtz Auto among the more ambitious modern autos for growers who want both speed and premium flower quality.
Genetics and Lineage

Guava Runtz Auto is officially Guava Auto RF3 × Mango Runtz F5 Auto. The Guava Auto side originated from a complicated Fast Buds breeding project based around Gorilla Cookies Auto, Kosher Cake, and Tropicana Cookies Auto genetics. Early generations displayed unusual fresh, green, and tropical aromatics, leading the breeder to continue selecting the line rather than abandoning it. Through subsequent generations, increasingly dense flowers, darker pigmentation, stronger structure, and more defined guava-like terpenes emerged. The refined Guava Auto RF3 parent used here represents the competition-level version of that work and became an Autoflower World Cup winner.

Mango Runtz F5 comes from Mephisto Genetics and has the pedigree (Creme de la Chem × Mango Smile) × White Runtz . Creme de la Chem contributes dense flower, Chem-style gas, and body weight, while Mango Smile introduces tropical fruit and brighter sativa influence. White Runtz adds candy sweetness, color, frost, and the modern Runtz character that helped turn the parent into a highly aromatic purple-leaning autoflower. Mephisto refined Mango Runtz through five generations, producing a small but terpene-heavy plant known for mango candy, grape-like sweetness, sour funk, burnt rubber, and fuel.

Fast Buds combined these two lines as an F1 rather than continuing either parental line independently. That choice produces strong hybrid vigor and brings more size and growth energy from Guava Auto into the naturally compact Mango Runtz structure. The finished marijuana plant therefore contains several distinct aromatic families at once: Cookies and tropical citrus from the Guava side, Chem and mango from Mephisto genetics, and candy-gas character from White Runtz. Rather than tasting like a simple Runtz variation, the cross has a much more tropical identity.
Effects and Experience

The opening effects generally favor the brighter side of the hybrid. Mood can rise quickly, conversation feels easier, and creative or recreational activities may become more engaging. Some consumers find the early phase energetic enough for music, gaming, light projects, or social situations, while still maintaining the smoothness expected from a balanced hybrid. It is less sharply stimulating than a traditional narrow-leaf sativa and instead produces a broad euphoric lift that feels relaxed around the edges.

As the session develops, physical calm gradually becomes more noticeable. The body can feel lighter and looser while the mind settles into an easygoing state rather than losing awareness completely. This combination helps explain why the cultivar can feel both uplifting and relaxed within the same session. Smaller servings may preserve more of the social and creative side, while stronger doses bring considerably more body weight and can encourage appetite, lounging, or quiet evening entertainment.

Potency changes the equation significantly. With breeder-listed THC reaching approximately 30%, Guava Runtz Auto is capable of producing intense intoxication despite its sweet flavor and approachable hybrid character. Experienced consumers may appreciate the strength, but people with low tolerance should start conservatively. Excessive intake can turn an otherwise enjoyable euphoric experience into dizziness, dry mouth, mental fog, or temporary anxiety, particularly if repeated doses are taken before the first one has fully developed.
Medical Benefits

The combination of uplift and relaxation may interest medical cannabis consumers who prefer effects that do not immediately become sedating. During the first portion of the experience, the brighter mood and increased mental engagement may make everyday stress, low motivation, or mental fatigue feel less intrusive. At moderate amounts, the strain can remain comfortable enough for low-pressure daytime or early-evening activities without forcing the consumer into complete inactivity.

The physical component becomes more relevant later. Muscular tension and generalized discomfort may feel less prominent as the body relaxes, and stronger servings can encourage rest or increase appetite. That transition gives Guava Runtz Auto more versatility than cannabis that remains purely stimulating throughout the experience. At the same time, its very high THC potential means dose control matters, especially for people who are sensitive to anxious or racing thoughts.

CBD remains below 1%, making this a strongly THC-dominant cultivar rather than a balanced medical strain . Fast Buds does not publish standardized individual terpene percentages for every harvest, so therapeutic decisions should not be based on assumptions about one specific terpene being dominant. Batch testing, personal tolerance, existing medications, and previous response to high-THC weed provide a more useful guide than the strain name alone.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Guava is the defining note and gives the strain a fresher tropical direction than the usual berry-and-candy interpretation of Runtz genetics. Mature flowers can release a sharp exotic fruit aroma immediately after the container is opened, with mango and generalized tropical sweetness building underneath. There is enough brightness in the bouquet to suggest freshly cut fruit rather than syrup alone, which reflects the distinctive character selected through the Guava Auto breeding project.

Mango Runtz adds the candy side of the equation. Beneath the guava appear mango sweets, grape-like fruit, sour candy, and a deeper layer of gas. Creme de la Chem ancestry can introduce a slightly rubbery or chemical edge, preventing the aroma from becoming overly soft, while White Runtz contributes rich sugary depth. The result can smell like tropical candy stored beside something distinctly fuel-heavy and funky.

Flavor follows a similar progression. Sweet tropical fruit arrives first, with guava and mango dominating the inhale before sourness and gas begin to appear. The exhale can become deeper and more resinous, especially with combustion, while vaporization tends to preserve the brighter fruit and candy notes. Careful drying and curing are particularly worthwhile because the cultivar’s strongest appeal lies in the contrast between fresh tropical aroma and the heavier candy-gas foundation underneath.
Growing Information

Guava Runtz Auto develops with the vigor expected from an F1 hybrid. Plants generally reach approximately 70–120 cm, combining a manageable overall height with enough branching to support a substantial canopy. Fast Buds describes the structure as consistent across the population, with compact internodal spacing, strong lateral development, and dense flower formation. The strain can be grown indoors, outdoors, in greenhouses, or under mixed lighting, making it adaptable to a wide range of cultivation environments.

The entire autoflowering cycle takes approximately 8–9 weeks, and indoor production can reach around 450–600 g/m² under optimized conditions. Light low-stress training can help spread branches and expose additional bud sites, although aggressive high-stress techniques are unnecessary when working with such a short life cycle. Stable irrigation, adequate root volume, and strong lighting are more important than trying to manipulate the plant repeatedly. Dense flowers and strong aroma also make good air circulation and odor control increasingly important during late bloom.

Outdoor yields range from approximately 60–300 grams per plant depending on container size, sunlight, temperature, root development, and general plant health. Because the cultivar flowers automatically, growers schedule harvest by germination date rather than waiting for shortening autumn days. Two main visual expressions add interest to larger runs: one can become intensely dark or nearly black, while another remains greener with darker pigmentation arriving near the finish. Both retain vigorous growth and similar tropical candy terpenes, so keeper selection can focus on structure, yield, resin, and color without sacrificing the central flavor profile.
FAQ
What strains make Guava Runtz Auto?

Guava Runtz Auto was bred by Fast Buds from Guava Auto RF3 × Mango Runtz F5 Auto. Guava Auto descends from Gorilla Cookies Auto, Kosher Cake, and Tropicana Cookies Auto breeding, while Mephisto Genetics’ Mango Runtz is (Creme de la Chem × Mango Smile) × White Runtz.
Is Guava Runtz Auto indica or sativa?

Fast Buds classifies the cultivar as approximately 50% indica and 50% sativa. Its effects reflect that balance, combining an uplifting, creative beginning with a smoother relaxing body effect later in the session.
How much THC does Guava Runtz Auto have?

The breeder lists THC at up to approximately 30%, with CBD below 1%. Actual potency varies according to phenotype, lighting, cultivation practices, harvest maturity, curing, and laboratory methodology.
How long does Guava Runtz Auto take from seed to harvest?
The breeder lists approximately 8–9 weeks for the complete autoflowering cycle. Because it flowers automatically, no switch to a 12/12 photoperiod is necessary.
How much does Guava Runtz Auto yield?

Indoor yields are approximately 450–600 g/m², while outdoor plants can produce roughly 60–300 grams each. Light intensity, root space, nutrition, training, environmental stability, and plant health all influence final production.
Final Thoughts on Guava Runtz Auto

Guava Runtz Auto represents a different direction in autoflower breeding because both sides of the cross arrive with substantial breeding history behind them. Fast Buds’ Guava Auto RF3 brings competition-tested vigor, unusual tropical aromatics, and refined structure, while Mephisto Genetics’ Mango Runtz F5 contributes candy gas, compact flower formation, and several generations of selection. Joining them as an F1 creates a cultivar built around hybrid vigor rather than simply adapting another photoperiod strain to automatic flowering.

Performance is one of its strongest advantages. Plants can reach 70–120 cm, finish in approximately 8–9 weeks, yield up to around 600 g/m² indoors, and produce as much as roughly 300 grams per plant outdoors under excellent conditions. The possibility of deep black coloration adds substantial visual appeal, but the greener phenotype remains equally relevant because both preserve the line’s tropical aromatic identity and dense bud formation.

For consumers, guava, mango, tropical fruit, sweet candy, sour funk, and gas create a profile that separates this weed strain from simpler dessert hybrids. The effects follow the same balanced theme, beginning euphoric and socially engaging before moving toward comfortable body relaxation. With THC reaching approximately 30%, Guava Runtz Auto combines speed, strong production, unusual color, intense fruit terpenes, and serious potency in one of the more distinctive modern autoflower packages.
